reasons.C: Short declaratives and clipped fragments with no contractions, plus the passage's dry, exact, reasoned-out stance (why the long way is steadier); the fragment runs and the slightly warm nodding ending lay it on a little thick.
reasons.B: Right register and short sentence rhythm with small paragraphs, but it leans on generalising asides ('so I do not have to think', 'Everyone is in their own morning', 'Back to normal') that are more explanatory and less precisely observed than the author.
reasons.A: Long, smoothly subordinated sentences, abstract reflective diction ('familiar strangers', 'quiet agreement') and an essayistic arc; nothing like the author's terse, flat, counted-out voice.
